answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Stamped crane operator certification with crane operators attestation changes that arithmetic: a certification operators renew after assessed lifts, so the oasis for each fake is paid in the real world. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the harbor is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the wharf of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
